# Prosepal

> iOS app for generating thoughtful greeting card messages from occasion, relationship, tone, length, and optional personal details.

Last updated: 2026-06-03

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.prosepal.app/): App marketing homepage and iOS download link
- [Messages](https://www.prosepal.app/messages/): Compact message examples hub for common occasions
- [Guides](https://www.prosepal.app/blog/): Evergreen card writing guides
- [Support](https://www.prosepal.app/support)
- [Privacy](https://www.prosepal.app/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.prosepal.app/terms)

## Product Snapshot

- Primary platform: iOS
- App Store ID: 6757088726
- Core flow: choose occasion, relationship, tone, length, recipient name, and optional personal details
- Output: three greeting card message options per generation
- Coverage: 40 occasions, 14 relationship types, 9 tones, 3 lengths

## SEO Surface

- Message examples hub: one consolidated page
- Blog guides: 7
- Removed generated long-tail message detail pages redirect to `/messages/`

## Crawler Policy

Search crawlers are allowed. Model-training crawlers listed in `robots.txt` are blocked.
